ConfigurationMetadata.Description: Human-readable notes about the configuration. All documentation lives here — not as inline comments — because JSON does not support comments.
Guidance: Keep production secrets out of this file. Use 'dotnet user-secrets' in development and environment variables or Azure Key Vault in production.
Seed:AdminEmail and Seed:AdminPass control the seeded admin account. Set them via 'dotnet user-secrets set Seed:AdminEmail you@example.com' — never commit real values here.
Cache settings control in-memory behavior for fuzzy search. Adjust expirations based on traffic and memory constraints.
AllowedHosts is set to 'localhost' here. Override via the ASPNETCORE_AllowedHosts environment variable in production (e.g. yourdomain.com;www.yourdomain.com).
Email credentials MUST be supplied via 'dotnet user-secrets' in development or environment variables / Key Vault in production. Never commit real credentials to source control.
Logging:LogLevel controls the verbosity of framework and application logs.
Search:Fuzzy:CandidateLimit — candidates considered per query. TopResults — results returned to the caller.
Search:Fuzzy:WindowMinDelta / WindowMaxDelta — sliding-window sizes for fuzzy substring matching.
Search:Fuzzy:PartialRatioThreshold — minimum fuzzy score (0-100) to accept a match. RankingThreshold — secondary ranking cutoff.
Search:ReindexIntervalMinutes — how often the background service rebuilds fuzzy suggestions (default 360 = 6 h).
Moderation:BaseUrl is used for generating absolute links in moderation email notifications. Must include protocol and domain (e.g. https://myapp.com).
Database:ApplyMigrationsOnStartup — defaults to true in Development, false everywhere else. Override with caution.
Database:AllowMigrationInProduction — must ALSO be true to permit startup migrations outside Development. Both keys protect against accidental production migration.
PayPal:ClientId and PayPal:Secret MUST be set via user-secrets or environment variables. Never commit real credentials. Environment: 'sandbox' for testing, 'live' for production.
ReCaptcha:SiteKey and ReCaptcha:SecretKey MUST be set via user-secrets or environment variables. Register at https://www.google.com/recaptcha/admin.
